title: TriMet Park and Rides
description: TriMet park and ride locations. 46 Point features covering TriMet's service district in the Portland, Oregon metropolitan area, published by TriMet as `tm_parkride` and last updated at the source on June 23, 2026. This is a cloud-native mirror: the same data as GeoParquet and PMTiles, reprojected to WGS84 from TriMet's NAD83(HARN) / Oregon North (ft). The original Shapefile, KML and metadata page are linked as assets. Column descriptions and code lists are TriMet's own, taken from https://developer.trimet.org/gis/meta_tm_parkride.shtml.

data.title: TriMet Park and Rides (GeoParquet)
data.description: TriMet park and ride locations. Reprojected to WGS84 from TriMet's NAD83(HARN) / Oregon North (ft) source, Hilbert-ordered, zstd-compressed, with a GeoParquet 1.1 bbox covering column for row-group pruning.

table:columns.name: address
table:columns.description: Park and ride street address or major intersection.

table:columns.name: city
table:columns.description: City in which park and ride is located.

table:columns.name: county
table:columns.description: County in which park and ride is located.

table:columns.name: zipcode
table:columns.description: Zipcode in which park and ride is located.

table:columns.name: owner
table:columns.description: Indicates whether a park and ride is TriMet owned or a shared use facility. Values: TriMet = TriMet owned; Shared = Shared use.

table:columns.name: spaces
table:columns.description: Indicates number of parking spaces available at park and ride.

table:columns.name: status
table:columns.description: Operational status of park and ride. Values: Existing = Park and ride is operational; Planned = Park and ride is in advanced planning stages; UC = Park and ride is under construction.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, WGS84 longitude and latitude. Reprojected from TriMet's EPSG:2913 (NAD83(HARN) / Oregon North (ft)).

visual.title: TriMet Park and Rides (PMTiles)
visual.description: Vector tiles for web display, layer name `park-and-rides`. Built with tippecanoe keeping every feature at every zoom, so what a map draws matches the GeoParquet exactly.

thumbnail.title: TriMet Park and Rides preview
thumbnail.description: Rendered from this collection's styles/default.json with MapLibre GL Native, over a light basemap. WebP is allowed for thumbnails by spec PR portolan-sdi/portolan-spec#121, which this catalog targets; Portolan 0.1 alone permits only PNG and JPEG.

style.title: TriMet Park and Rides
style.description: The 46 park and ride facilities in TriMet blue. A steady mark size makes this the right style when the question is where the lots are rather than how big they are.

style-by-capacity.title: TriMet Park and Rides by capacity
style-by-capacity.description: Scales each mark by SPACES and ramps its color with it, over a range that runs from small lots up to the 750-space Clackamas Town Center garage. Area, not radius, tracks capacity, so a lot that looks twice as big holds roughly twice as many cars. The whole system holds 12,501 spaces.

style-by-owner.title: TriMet Park and Rides by ownership
style-by-owner.description: Separates the 32 TriMet-owned lots from the 14 shared-use facilities. The distinction matters in practice: shared lots are much smaller, 929 spaces between them against 11,572 in the TriMet-owned lots, and their availability depends on an agreement with the property owner.

style-labeled.title: TriMet Park and Rides with names and capacity
style-labeled.description: Capacity-scaled marks labeled with the facility name and its space count, so a reader can identify a specific lot without clicking it.
